product: Usage tracking adds session metadata and token details (Public Preview)
tagline: The system.ai gateway.usage system table now includes coding agent session metadata and invocation source.
what_it_does: The system.ai gateway.usage system table now includes coding agent session metadata and invocation source. New token detail fields capture tokens written to the 5 minute and 1 hour prompt caches, along with file and web search counts. This page describes how to monitor usage for Unity Gateway services using the usage tracking system table.
why_it_matters: For model requests, it records metrics such as token usage and latency.
